nodes.name: Validate campaign_id
nodes.notes: Rejects anything that isn't UUID-shaped before it's sent onward.

nodes.name: Start campaign build
nodes.notes: Calls code/api_server.py (a small persistent FastAPI service — see n8n/README.md). Needs INTERNAL_API_URL (e.g. http://your-host:8000) and INTERNAL_API_KEY set as n8n environment variables, matching the .env values on the machine running api_server.py. The build itself runs in the background on that service; this call just confirms it started. The campaigns row's status/error_message (visible on the dashboard) is the source of truth for whether it actually succeeded.

parameters.text: =Campaign build started for {{ $('Validate campaign_id').item.json.campaign_id }}. Check the dashboard for status once it completes (usually under a minute).
